values.description: Nginx terminates TLS on :443 and proxies /api/** (customers/orders/payments/inventory/auth) to api-gateway. Requires `docker compose --profile https up -d` - see docs/SETUP_AND_DEPLOYMENT.md. Self-signed cert: in Postman, disable Settings > General > SSL certificate verification, or Insomnia > Preferences > General > Validate SSL Certificates, for this to work.
Stays plain HTTP even with --profile https: nginx has no proxy route for notification-service (only /api/** -> api-gateway) and the service has no TLS listener of its own.

Stays plain HTTP even with --profile https: product-service isn't part of docker-compose.yml at all (run it separately), and like notification-service it has no nginx route or TLS listener of its own.
Set this from the Login response's "token" field
